difficulty_reason: The lemma proves base change for the derived direct image along a cartesian square of a ringed site, for modules (statement lines 4688-4701, with the Xy-pic square delivered verbatim). The non-formal content is the passage from the underived to the derived statement. The claim is H2: one identification plus one passage to the derived category.
